dialogues.speaker: Fatui Action Log: Part I
dialogues.text: "...The people from Liyue have left their large cannon behind. It shows signs of maintenance. It seems that they have not given up on re-opening the mine..."

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Action Log: Part I
dialogues.text: "...Scouted the area where the crystal fragment was found, clearing a path for others to follow, before returning here to await further orders..."

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Action Log: Part I
dialogues.text: "...The sonic catcher is reacting to a greater pulse coming from deeper within the mine... It is a grand, but dull noise..."

dialogues.speaker: Fatui Action Log: Part I
dialogues.text: "...According to sample analysis, the crystal may be older than The Chasm itself. However, we have not found any systemic signs of ancient civilizations nearby..."
